entries.alternate: 0805L150SLYR if nuisance trips are seen at 1.75x and max brightness - saves ~3x more but raises Itrip to 3.00 A, above F1's useful band

entries.eco: ECO-8: replaces 150060VS75000 (AlInGaP, 570 nm, 12-40 mcd). Identical body and identical recommended land pattern 0.8/0.8/2.4 mm, same polarity (pin 1 = K). With R25 = 22k it runs at 0.124 mA and is brighter than the incumbent is today at 0.93 mA.

entries.desc: Red LED, Vf 2 V, 250 mcd at 20 mA

entries.eco: ECO-8: replaces RC0603FR-071M78L (1.78 M). Sets VOUT3 = 1.20 x (1 + 1.69/1.00) = 3.228 V instead of 3.336 V; worst case 3.12 V, still 0.12 V above the 3.0 V at which onsemi specify the NCV8164 LDOs.
ECO-8: replaces 3.3k. Pairs with the DL1 swap.

ECO-8: replaces 10k on both. Cuts the statically-biased brownout-latch current from 389 uA to 81 uA off VBATT. Forced beta stays at 2.4 against hFE minima of 60 (2N3906) and 40 (2N3904). Same part as R12/R17/R64, already on the BOM.

ECO-8: replaces 1k. Cuts the post-brownout latched-off drain from 2.40 mA to 240 uA. Must be paired with R24 = 1M, otherwise /EN falls from 0.990 x SW to 0.909 x SW and Q10B's already-marginal gate drive gets worse.

ECO-8: replaces 100k. Restores the /EN divider ratio alongside R11 = 10k. Verified against the LTC3527 SHDN input current (1 uA typ / 2 uA max): /EN = 2.356 V at SW = 2.4 V and 1.762 V at SW = 1.8 V, both far above the 0.88 V VIH.

ECO-8: replaces 100k on the MIC1553 CS pull-up. 470k not the 1M the review proposed: the MIC1553 datasheet gives no numeric CS leakage spec and warns that a floating CS is unpredictable, and the worst-case CS-high threshold is 0.72 x VS = 3.61 V, not the nominal 2/3.

ECO-8 (BOM-only, not expressible in a KiCad Value field): replaces C0603C102K5RACTU (X7R, +/-10%). These are the Sallen-Key FEEDBACK caps, i.e. the ones that set Q, and their partners C26/C31 are already C0G. X7R drifts +/-15% over temperature against C0G's +/-30 ppm/C, so a handheld warming in the hand detunes half of each filter section.
ECO-8 (BOM-only): replaces C0603C332K5RACTU (X7R, +/-10%). Same reasoning as C24/C32.
